cohort: Women undergoing their first vaginal birth, comparing those with a previous cesarean delivery to primigravid women
finding: Vacuum assisted vaginal delivery at first vaginal birth following a previous cesarean delivery is associated with a higher risk of maternal postpartum hemorrhagic complications.
mod_finding: Vacuum assisted vaginal delivery at first vaginal birth following a previous cesarean delivery is associated with a higher risk of maternal postpartum hemorrhagic complications.
